assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容组织、讨论与返修，官方几何发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry is provisional.

assumptions.statement_zh: 适老化改造涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护、老旧小区改造条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and renovation conditions are unknown; concept-level only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 老年人口、改造户数与服务需求数据仅有公开口径，本方案不引用未核实数值，不编造改造户数、床位或服务量数据。
assumptions.statement_en: No unverified elder-population or renovation statistics are cited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 个体服务流程（求助、预约、健康提醒、家属联动与服务工单）仅在业务必要字段范围内处理个人信息；处理者、拟议合法性基础、权限、保存删除与撤回规则待部署前专业核验。匿名/聚合仅用于统计输出，不进行个体识别式追踪、不建立大规模行为画像，关键决策人工复核。
assumptions.statement_en: Individual-service workflows (help, booking, health reminders, family linking and work orders) use only necessary fields; controller, proposed legal basis, access, retention/deletion and withdrawal rules require professional review before deployment. Anonymization/aggregation applies only to statistics; no individual-identifying tracking or large behavior profile is allowed, and key decisions receive human review.

assumptions.statement_zh: 正式案例池仅使用 sources.json 中登记的一手机构页面事实转述，不复制页面图形、标识或版式；六个适老政策/项目条目统一降为 background_only。品牌名称「颐养智环/AGE·JZ」为原创概念名，概念阶段未完成官方在先权利检索，按内部工作代号处理，检索完成前不对外注册与正式使用。
assumptions.statement_en: The formal case pool uses only factual paraphrase from first-party institutional pages registered in sources.json; no page graphics, marks or layouts are reused. Six aging-policy/project entries are uniformly background_only. The original concept names remain internal codenames until prior-rights clearance.

assumptions.statement_zh: 试点设置停止/退出条件：试点KPI未达预期、发生重大服务质量或安全问题、或现场踏勘显示选址不适时启动撤收或调整；撤收按部件清单与预约记录完成退租与归还。
assumptions.statement_en: Pilots have defined stop/exit conditions and dismantling procedures.

assumptions.statement_zh: 日间照护与健康检测表述均为概念机制建议，实际服务须依法取得资质并接受监管，本方案不替代法定管理职责。
assumptions.statement_en: Elder-care mechanisms are concept suggestions subject to statutory licensing.
